## Products

* [**Proximity**](https://github.com/prox-hr/proximity): AI-powered job semantic matching. Upload a PDF, get matched. No forms, no keyword filters.

  Born as a FIAP Global Solution project and winner of GS 2025.2 "Future at Work", responding to *"How can technology make work more human, inclusive, and sustainable in the future?"*.

Site: [proximity.luisfuturist.com](https://proximity.luisfuturist.com)
